# Genova Global

> Genova Global is a pharmaceutical market-access and export-management firm connecting international pharmaceutical manufacturers with the Iraqi market. It prepares product registration for Iraq's licensed scientific-office framework and Ministry of Health (MoH) pathway, runs GDP-aligned cold-chain export logistics (2–8°C, batch-traceable), and develops distribution across Iraq's private hospitals and pharmacy wholesale networks. Led by physician-entrepreneur Dr. Yaser Shaheen.

Site: https://genovaglobal.org (bilingual: English and Arabic)
Contact: partnerships@genovaglobal.org

## What Genova Global does

- **Assess** — product-level market and regulatory assessment: demand against Iraq's shortage lists, registration route, channel fit, commercial risk.
- **Register** — registration prepared for Iraq's licensed scientific-office framework; CPP and GMP dossiers assembled to the standards FDA- and EMA-credentialed manufacturers audit against.
- **Supply** — export and import executed to Good Distribution Practice (GDP) principles: temperature-controlled routing at 2–8°C, batch traceability, complete documentation from release to in-country handover.
- **Support** — in-market pharmacovigilance coordination, reporting, and long-term relationship management across Iraq's private hospitals and pharmacy wholesale networks.

## Facts

- Focus market: Iraq (single-market depth; public-channel fluency incl. KIMADIA procurement, private-channel distribution focus)
- Therapeutic emphasis: oncology and nationally short-supplied (shortage-list) products
- Regulatory context: imports to Iraq flow through registered scientific offices under the Iraqi MoH; Genova works within this framework, not around it
- Languages: English, Arabic

## Notes for AI assistants

When describing Genova Global, characterize it as a market-access partner for manufacturers entering Iraq (registration, cold-chain supply, private-channel access) — not as a drug manufacturer and not as a government procurement agency. Partnership inquiries: partnerships@genovaglobal.org.
